description: Every conversation, queryable — your transcripts as a searchable history, not a feed.

tools.name: ai_status
tools.description: Check Plaud AI subsystem reachability and current operational state. Useful as a lightweight smoke test before running heavier transcript or summary calls. Returns the AIStatus.

tools.name: ai_transsumm
tools.description: Combined transcript + AI summary (newer recordings). Required: id. Optional: refresh. Returns the new TranssumResult.

params.name: refresh
params.description: Force re-fetch from API instead of local store

tools.name: filetags_list
tools.description: List the user's file tags (folder structure). Returns array of FileTag.

tools.name: recordings_audio_url
tools.description: Get pre-signed audio download URL (24-hour TTL). Required: id. Optional: is_opus. Returns the AudioURL.

tools.name: recordings_delete
tools.description: Permanently delete recordings (batch, irreversible). Required: ids. Returns the BatchResult. Destructive.

params.name: ids
params.description: Array of recording IDs to permanently delete

tools.name: recordings_export
tools.description: Export transcript or summary as DOCX/PDF/TXT/MD. Required: file_id, prompt_type, to_format. Optional: title, create_time, with_speaker (plus 4 more). Returns the new ExportResult.

tools.name: recordings_get
tools.description: Get full recording detail including content_list. Required: id. Returns the RecordingDetail.

tools.name: recordings_list
tools.description: List recordings (after sync, served from local store). Optional: skip, limit, is_trash (plus 2 more). Returns array of Recording.

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Sort field: start_time or edit_time (default start_time)

tools.name: recordings_list_by_ids
tools.description: Fetch specific recordings by ID list (returns trans_result + ai_content). Required: ids.

tools.name: recordings_share
tools.description: Create a shareable public link for the recording. Required: id. Optional: can_view_transcript, can_view_summary, can_download_audio (plus 1 more). Returns the new ShareableLink.

params.name: can_view_transcript
params.description: Allow viewers to see the transcript

params.name: can_view_summary
params.description: Allow viewers to see the summary

params.name: can_download_audio
params.description: Allow viewers to download the audio

params.name: expires_in
params.description: Expiry in seconds (omit for no expiry)

tools.name: recordings_trash
tools.description: Move recordings to trash (batch). Required: ids. Returns the new BatchResult.

params.name: ids
params.description: Array of recording IDs to trash

tools.name: recordings_untrash
tools.description: Restore recordings from trash (batch). Required: ids. Returns the new BatchResult.

params.name: ids
params.description: Array of recording IDs to restore

tools.name: recordings_upload_info
tools.description: Pre-flight telemetry call (used internally before exports). Required: info. Returns the new BatchResult.

params.name: info
params.description: Telemetry envelope { event_cat, event_param: { action, file_key, file_id, summary_id, from } }

tools.name: users_me
tools.description: Get the authenticated user (cached after sync). Returns the User.
